native_mechanisms: Lay both symbol-coil rows side by side in the sun and count only the fires where opposite coils match exactly (parallel position-wise match counting, no grid).
Allow the boundary door between the rows to break exactly once per crossing: one coil crouches past a quarrel out of step, tried at every quarrel point, never twice.
Store each crossing's fire-pile in its own room, sink failed/twice-broken crossings into the underground tower, and bring back only the highest pile as the answer.
core_technique: Ukkonen-banded anti-diagonal SIMD Needleman-Wunsch, with an O(n) vectorized zero-gap match count plus an exact best-single-gap prefix scan used only as a lower bound to size (or occasionally skip) the band.
